name: Mount Mulanje Cultural Landscape
description: Rising abruptly from the plains of southern Malawi, about 65 km east of Blantyre, Mount Mulanje is one of the world's largest inselbergs, a massive isolated rock mass. Its summit, Sapitwa Peak, reaches 3,002 m and is the highest point in the country. The Yao, Mang'anja and Lhomwe peoples revere the mountain as home to gods, spirits and ancestors, and they keep its sacredness alive through ritual.
